description_en: Creates or updates a message queue (MQ) subscription
kebab_example: aliyun bailianvoicebot update-subscription --business-unit-id llm-c11iig67g863rih8 --mq-type ROCKET_MQ_4 --event-subscriptions Released --biz-endpoint rmq-cn-l4p89zajz67.cn-hangzhou.rmq.aliyuncs.com:8080 --topic test --user-name username --password pwd --mq-instance-id rmq-cn-l4p89zajz67.cn --producer-id user1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSubscription

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Model Studio business space
parameters.name: business_unit_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the message queue service. Valid values are `ROCKET_MQ_4` and `ROCKET_MQ_5`, which correspond to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ
parameters.name: mq_type

parameters.help_en: A list of events to subscribe to
parameters.name: event_subscriptions

parameters.help_en: The endpoint. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_4` or `ROCKET_MQ_5`
parameters.help_zh: 接入点(使用 ROCKET_MQ_4、ROCKET_MQ_5 时必填)
parameters.name: endpoint

parameters.help_en: The topic of the queue. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_4` or `ROCKET_MQ_5`
parameters.help_zh: 队列 topic(使用 ROCKET_MQ_4、ROCKET_MQ_5 时必填)
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The username for authentication. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_5`
parameters.help_zh: 用户名(使用 ROCKET_MQ_5 时必填)
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for authentication. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_5`
parameters.help_zh: 密码(使用 ROCKET_MQ_5 时必填)
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_5`
parameters.help_zh: MQ 实例 ID(使用 ROCKET_MQ_5 时必填)
parameters.name: mq_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the producer. This parameter is required if `MqType` is set to `ROCKET_MQ_4`
parameters.help_zh: 生产者标识(使用 ROCKET_MQ_4 时必填)
parameters.name: producer_id
